theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_un_tangent_subspace
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → ∀ x ∈ M, ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), (Q : Set (Euclid P)) = tangentSpace M x ∧ Module.finrank ℝ Q = m ∧ Q ≤ A₀
